title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1973-11-11
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Samplitude Professional v9.02 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat (44.1k) D

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a mellow 1973‑74 style show, highlighted by stellar Dark Star, Loose Lucy jam, and an unforgettable Eyes of the World.
ai_review.review: The recording is a sound‑board source that sounds pleasant and mostly clear, with only occasional “wonky” moments that don’t detract from the listening experience. Musically the concert is praised as a masterful, groove‑filled performance featuring standout renditions of Dark Star, Loose Lucy, Eyes of the World, Mind Left Body and classic ’73‑’74 numbers such as They Love Each Other, China Cat Sunflower, I Know You Rider and Here Comes Sunshine.

ai_rating.rationale: All ten reviewers rate the show 4–5 stars, overwhelmingly praising both performance and recording; minor technical quirks are noted but do not lower the overall high appraisal.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and pleasant soundboard mix; a few reviewers note occasional wonky or slightly uneven sections, but overall the audio is listenable and captures the band well.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers describe a consistent, mellow groove that sustains through both sets, with the second set often singled out for its relaxed pacing and extended improvisations.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers rave about Jerry's sweet, raindrop‑like guitar tone, especially on Dark Star and the Wolf era sound.
band_member_comments.Bob: One reviewer notes that Bob’s vocal can be a little rough, but his contribution is still praised as part of the overall brilliance.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's keyboards are highlighted for their organic, jazzy texture that defines the 73‑74 period sound.
